delegation_workflow: Use Claude Code with GLM Flash (glm-4.5-flash) as primary model and DeepSeek (deepseek-chat) as fallback for building the zippp bilingual landing page and app. The workflow includes: 1) Print mode for one-shot tasks with --max-turns 10, 2) Interactive tmux mode for multi-turn work, 3) Isolated git worktrees for features, 4) Permission mode set to acceptEdits for file edits, 5) Comprehensive project context in CLAUDE.md. Run './setup-claude.sh' to initialize, then use 'claude -p "task description"' for development tasks.
